status: REGISTERED STARTING VALUES — not fitted, not evaluated against any outcome
note: Every number the model uses, registered BEFORE any result exists (research/registration.json). Values marked `selectable` may be chosen ONLY on the training windows, from the candidates listed, by the selection rule in the registration; the chosen set is then frozen (config/model_v1.json, with its sha256 in a new registration version) BEFORE the retrospective holdout is scored once. Nothing here may be tuned on the 2025-26 holdout or on the live 2026-27 season. A change after the freeze is a new model version (registration §weekly_learning).

base_engine.params: basketball/ncaam_forecast/config/selection_v1.json `chosen` (hash 7807a94ff33649c6), chosen on 2012-2019 only; used unchanged except the season-start prior, which NCAAM-EARLY replaces
base_engine.home_advantage: the engine's own fitted home term (inside the rating model, so ratings are near neutral); neutral site = 0. NCAAM-EARLY adds no second home term.

player_value.formula: Per player, last season, per 100 team possessions he was on the floor for (on-floor possessions = minutes / team minutes x 5 x team possessions): OFF = (points + 0.5 x assists + 0.6 x offensive rebounds - 0.9 x turnovers - 0.4 x missed field goals - 0.2 x missed free throws) per 100 on-floor possessions minus the D-I average of that rate; DEF = (0.6 x defensive rebounds + 1.0 x steals + 0.7 x blocks - 0.2 x fouls) per 100 on-floor possessions minus the D-I average. VALUE = OFF + DEF, scaled by the share of the team's minutes he is expected to play. Box-score only, documented, no black box.

shrink_minutes.rule: a rate is shrunk toward the replacement level with weight minutes / (minutes + shrink_minutes)

replacement_level.unit: points per 100 on-floor possessions vs D-I average

d1_to_d1.rule: factor = 1 + w x (source conference strength / destination conference strength - 1), strengths from EdgeDesk's own prior-season ratings

fixed_level_factors.note: multiply last season's value; heavy discounts with wide uncertainty; registered, not fitted to any holdout

transfer_translation.defense_credit: defensive value translates at the `def` factor (offense translates more cleanly)

usage_adjustment.rule: a player with usage >= 25% moving to a stronger conference keeps factor x 0.9 on offense; a player with usage <= 15% keeps factor x 1.05; otherwise unchanged

freshmen.rule: by recruiting stars when the recruit record exists, else the D-I freshman average; high variance

value_by_stars.unit: VALUE points per 100 on-floor possessions vs D-I average

expected_minutes.rule: start from last season's minutes share (returners and D-I transfers, translated), freshmen and unknowns at a prior share by stars (5: 0.55, 4: 0.40, 3: 0.20, unrated 0.10); normalise to 200 player-minutes per game, capped at 0.85 per player; coach rotation tendency is not used in v0 (no owned source)

preseason_prior.rule: team OFF/DEF prior = carried prior-season rating (engine `carry`) blended with the roster-built rating (sum of expected-minutes-weighted translated values), weight on the roster build = roster_weight

coach_change.rule: a coaching change shrinks the carried part toward the roster build by a further coach_shrink

preseason_prior.tempo: prior tempo = continuity-weighted blend of last season's adjusted tempo and the head coach's career tempo residual when a coach record with history exists; else last season's

variance.rule: team rating variance = base prior variance x (1 + a1 x unknown_minutes_share + a2 x non_d1_minutes_share + a3 x freshman_minutes_share + a4 x new_coach + a5 x (1 - returning_minutes_share))

in_season_update.rule: Bayesian normal-normal update of the engine's rating after each game; the prior's weight decays with games played; a high-variance team's prior is weaker from the start, so it updates faster
in_season_update.recency: the engine's own (no recency decay chosen in selection_v1); not changed in v0

game_projection.margin: rating difference + the engine's home term (neutral 0)
game_projection.total: projected possessions x (offence vs opposing defence) / 100, both teams

base_margin_sd.rule: inflated by both teams' rating variance: sd = sqrt(base^2 + var_home + var_away)
base_margin_sd.selectable_from_training: fitted by maximum likelihood on the training windows only

base_total_sd.selectable_from_training: fitted by maximum likelihood on the training windows only

outputs: cover probability at a market line
over probability at a market line

market.devig: the EdgeDesk two-way multiplicative de-vig (lib/edgedesk_calc.js noVigTwoWay); Shin where the capture layer already uses it, named on the row
market.reference: Pinnacle when captured, else the sharpest captured consensus; the reference used and its capture time are stored with every comparison
market.edge: model probability x best captured decimal price - 1
market.thin_market: fewer than 3 books on the market, or a Kalshi market below 500 contracts of volume, or a price older than 90 minutes at the comparison: flagged thin, never shown as an edge

conviction.note: Registered before any validation. Shown as Conviction (Low / Medium / High) only; no unit or stake is shown on any card.

variance_cap.value: the 60th percentile of team rating variance among D-I teams on the day
variance_cap.rule: both teams at or below the cap

tiers.HIGH: edge >= edge_high AND both teams' variance <= cap AND at least one non-price angle tag
tiers.MEDIUM: edge_low <= edge < edge_high, OR edge >= edge_high with a team's variance above the cap or no non-price angle
tiers.LOW: edge_floor <= edge < edge_low, OR the only angle is price_only
tiers.PASS: edge < edge_floor, OR a thin market, OR a stale price

internal_grading_units.note: for EdgeDesk's own grading and attribution only; never displayed

angle_tags.continuity_gap: returning-minutes share differs by >= 0.30 between the teams
angle_tags.transfer_translation: >= 25% of a team's expected minutes come from translated transfers and the translation moves its rating by >= 1.5 points
angle_tags.coach_change: either team has a first-season head coach (a coach record exists)
angle_tags.departed_production: a team lost >= 50% of last season's player value
angle_tags.pace_coach_history: the coach-history tempo prior moves projected possessions by >= 2

early_season_window: from each season's first regular-season game through 15 December (US Eastern date), inclusive
